items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: another fine southwestern band which I know you know well, maybe as much or more than me, was Nat Towles.

ctx.x: At different intervals, Artis was one of these come and go, he would be--another fine southwestern band which I know you know well, maybe as much or more than me, was Nat Towles.

I was with Nat Towles' band with Artis, a large percentage of 1944. Unfortunately he didn't get the recognition or the acclaim that he deserved. In another day Stan Kenton would have taken him with his band because he was as good a high note man as there was in the country, Artis Paul was.
